corrections.text: The article states OpenMDW is 'short for Open Model, Data, and Weights.' This expansion does not appear in any of the five cited sources (Michael Dolan's OSI submission or the openmdw.ai project site) and could not be independently verified against them.

The article quotes the OpenMDW-1.1 termination clause as beginning 'files, maintains, or voluntarily participates in a lawsuit...' The license text, as quoted in Michael Dolan's OSI submission, actually reads in the second person: 'If you file, maintain, or voluntarily participate in a lawsuit...' The article converted this to third person to fit the sentence; the substance of the clause is unchanged, but the opening words were not reproduced verbatim inside the quotation marks.
